Input

A single-line text field with a visible label, optional description, and an error message that is announced to assistive technology.

Basic usage

Install the package:

pnpm add @design-schema/react

Import the stylesheet once for the app, then the component:

import '@design-schema/react/index.css';
import { Input } from '@design-schema/react';

Examples

import { Input } from '@design-schema/react';

<Input label="Email address" name="email" />

PropTypeDefaultDescriptionPlatforms
label requiredstring—

Visible label (visually hidden with `hideLabel`). Never replaced by a placeholder.

Accessibility: Programmatically associated with the field (label/for on web, accessibilityLabel on native).

web, lit, rn, swiftui
name requiredstring—

Field name used by the enclosing Form when collecting values.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
valuestring—

Controlled value. Omit for an uncontrolled field.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
defaultValuestring—

Initial value for an uncontrolled field.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
placeholderstring—

Example input shown while empty. Never the only description of what to enter.

Accessibility: Placeholder text is muted and disappears on input; it is not a substitute for label or description.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
descriptionstring—

Persistent helper text below the label explaining format or purpose.

Accessibility: Linked to the field with aria-describedby / accessibilityHint.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
typetext | email | password | number | search | tel | urltext

Input type. Drives the keyboard on touch platforms and browser validation on web.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
requiredbooleanfalse

The field must have a value to submit. Shown in the label, not only by color.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
hideLabelbooleanfalse

Visually hide the label (it remains the accessible name). Only for a field whose context already names it: a DataGrid cell editor, a Search.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
sizesm | mdmd

sm for fields inside grid cells and toolbars: minimum target height, tighter padding, small type.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
disabledbooleanfalse

Not editable and not submitted. Stays visible and readable.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
invalidbooleanfalse

Marks the field as failing validation. Usually set by the Form; can be set directly.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
errorstring—

The error message. Setting it implies `invalid`. Explain what is wrong and how to fix it.

Accessibility: Rendered in the error slot with aria-describedby and role=alert so it is announced when it appears.

web, lit, rn, swiftui
autocompletestring—

HTML autocomplete token (e.g. `email`, `given-name`). Enables WCAG 1.3.5 input-purpose identification.

web, lit

Accessibility

Decisions this component leaves to you

Supply the label. It is associated with the control for you, but the words are yours — a placeholder is not a label.

Supply the error text when the value is invalid. The component links and announces it; it cannot write it.

Required props that carry accessibility meaning: label. Each is described in the props table above.

Implicit ARIA role: textbox.

Anatomy

labeldescriptionfielderrorMessage

What generation guarantees

Label association — The label is programmatically associated with the control, not merely placed beside it.

Error identification — An invalid value is identified in text and linked to the control — never signalled by colour alone.

Visible focus — Keyboard focus is always drawn, from the theme’s focus tokens, and is never removed.

Keyboard operable — Everything the pointer can do here, the keyboard can do — see the keyboard section.

Target size — Interactive targets are at least 44×44 CSS pixels — the touch-first size, not the minimum.

Contrast — Text and meaningful non-text contrast meets WCAG AA; the pairs are listed below.
